primary_sources.locator: published pp. 101903-3 to 101903-5; Collins angle, selection, normalization and uncertainties

final_paper_sample_description: seven out of ten periods, about two thirds of total 2022 statistics
source_version_status: Public archive served 2026-11-12, HTTP Last-Modified 2024-01-20; exact hashes are pinned. Relationship to the final September 2024 journal revision requires review; no final-version tag inferred.
hadron_mixture: Unidentified charged hadrons. The paper reports approximate pion fractions; do not substitute these for a certified species mixture or relabel h as pi.
source_normalization: Published Collins amplitudes are already divided by mean(DNN*f*Pt). Preserve values and sign; apply no additional depolarization, dilution or target-polarization correction.
projection_bins: Use only the printed projection edges and all six reported means; do not infer multidimensional integration cells or an acceptance model from the means.
error_policy: Preserve er_stat and er_tot separately. er_tot is reported total error, not a systematic component or an independent extra uncertainty. Never infer a point systematic by subtracting rounded variances, diagonalize an absent covariance, or count both columns independently.
replacement_policy: Partial and complete 2022 results are alternatives; a complete-sample scenario replaces the partial result. Keep x/z/pT projections and charge views as conservative alternatives until joint covariance/selection review.
derived_results_policy: The paper-derived transversity and truncated tensor charges reuse proton/deuteron and Belle information; do not add them as independent constraints beside their input measurements.
